title: Firewall: LAN-only tcp/8773 for the workout poke
objective: setup_wireguard_ssh.sh allow-workout-poke opens tcp/8773 from the LAN subnet only (never wg0), persists ALLOW_WORKOUT_POKE so every later re-apply keeps it, and leaves it closed when the flag is unset or false.
acceptance_criteria: ALLOW_WORKOUT_POKE unset or false renders no dport 8773 rule (test_wg_firewall.sh)
ALLOW_WORKOUT_POKE=true renders exactly one 8773 rule: ip saddr ${LAN_SUBNET} tcp dport 8773 accept (test_wg_firewall.sh)
allow_workout_poke saves the flag as true before verify-then-apply, and the applied ruleset carries the rule (test_wg_firewall.sh)
Host: nft list ruleset shows the rule after the user ran allow-workout-poke
verifier: lib/tests/test_wg_firewall.sh, lib/tests/run_all.sh in shell_coverage_jail.sh, nft list ruleset on the host
